# Canvas static vendor assets

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `marked.min.js` | Markdown parsing |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify HTML sanitization |
| `highlight.min.js` | Syntax highlighting |
| `highlight-github-dark.min.css` | Highlight.js theme |

Pinned versions are refreshed by `../../bin/vendor-web-ui-assets.sh` (from repo root).
